response.assayComponentEndpointDesc: Data from the assay component VALA_MIGHUV1_ScratchOnly_CellCount was analyzed at the endpoint, VALA_MIGHUV1_ScratchOnly_CellCount, in the positive analysis fitting direction relative to DMSO as the negative control and baseline of activity. Using a type of viability reporter, loss-of-signal activity can be used to understand viability. To generalize the intended target to other relatable targets, this assay endpoint is annotated to the cell cycle intended target family, where the subfamily is cell count.
response.assayComponentDesc: VALA_MIGHUV1_ScratchOnly_CellCount is the one of two assay components measured from the VALA_MIGHUV1_ScratchOnly assay. It is designed to make measurements of viability, a form of viability reporter, as detected with fluorescence intensity signals by HCS Fluorescent Imaging technology.
response.assayComponentTargetDesc: Changes in fluorescence intensity related to the number of DAPI labelled nuceli is indicative of the viability of the system.
response.assayDesc: VALA_MIGHUV1_ScratchOnly is a cell-based, multiplexed assay that uses umbilical vein-derived endothelial cells (HUVEC). Measurements were taken 24 hours after chemical dosing in a 96-well plate.
response.assaySourceDesc: Vala Sciences, a Contract Research Organization (CRO), provides cell-based assay services.
